Since the right angles are at \(B,C,D,E\), apply Pythagorean theorem sequentially:

\[
AC=\sqrt{AB^2+BC^2}=\sqrt{12^2+5^2}=13
\]
\[
AD=\sqrt{AC^2+CD^2}=\sqrt{13^2+8^2}=\sqrt{233}
\]
\[
AE=\sqrt{AD^2+DE^2}=\sqrt{233+12^2}=\sqrt{377}
\]
\[
AF=\sqrt{AE^2+EF^2}=\sqrt{377+8^2}=\sqrt{441}=21
\]

\boxed{21}
